name: Framepair
description: Two frames of the same weight, offset from each other on the diagonal.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 24%; top: 0; bottom: 24%; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; right: 0; top: 24%; bottom: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(270deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%), linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 10%, transparent 10%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
